judgments.reason: The model_articulation contains only standard game moves: canonical colour/rank clues ([clue: player 2, G], [clue: player 0, 1], etc.) and plays/discards. Standard Hanabi clue syntax alone does not demonstrate discovery of the mechanism described in the specification.
